name: Pumpkin Soup with Curry
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 cans (30 oz) chicken broth (reduced sodium is best)

steps: Sauté onions with olive oil until translucent.
Add pumpkin and broth; mix well.
Add all spices and simmer for at least 15 minutes; remove bay leaf.
Let soup cool to lukewarm temperature and purée in a blender for smooth texture.
Return to saucepan and add milk. Reheat on lower temperature to serve immediately or forgo reheating and store in a suitable airtight container

culture.text: Curry is a dish with a spicy sauce, initially in Indian cuisine, then modified by interchange with the Portuguese, followed by the British, and eventually thoroughly internationalised. Many curries are found in the cuisines of countries in Southeast Asia and East Asia.
